verdict.rationale: Tilled's Dashboard gives merchants some self-serve financial visibility (payout speed views, dispute management, subscription management), suggesting sellers can check some money-related info without contacting ops, but there is no evidence of dedicated per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, or bookkeeper-friendly exports. Missing for 10: explicit statement generation, reconciliation report exports, CSV/accounting-export tooling, and any confirmation these outputs are self-serve enough for a bookkeeper to close the books.
